aspect: The treatment is a routine, not a course
description: Inhaled corticosteroids and bronchodilators, ocular lubricants and eventual surgery, emollients and antihistamines, oxygen later. Daily, indefinitely, with the dose increasing over decades.
energy_note: A morning routine measured in decades.

aspect: Research continues and the wins are marginal
description: Trials such as atorvastatin for inflammatory markers in mustard-induced bronchitis represent the state of the art: incremental improvement of a marker, not restoration of the lung.
energy_note: Progress measured in cytokines, not in breath.

aspect: Immune suppression means every ordinary illness is worse
description: Sulfur mustard suppresses immune function and bone marrow; innate immune abnormalities have been documented in Iranian veterans three decades after exposure. A winter virus is not a winter virus for these patients.
energy_note: Everyone else's cold is your hospital admission.

aspect: The psychological treatment barely exists in the same place as the physical
description: Pulmonology, ophthalmology, dermatology and psychiatry in four buildings, four waiting lists and four sets of notes, for one injury, in a country under sanctions.
energy_note: One injury, four queues, no coordination.

aspect: SECONDARY - the decline is visible to the family, on a schedule
description: Children watch a parent get measurably worse each year. The anticipatory grief starts decades before the death and does not shorten the grief afterwards.
energy_note: Mourning someone for twenty years while they are alive.
